lessons.aggregate_audio: scripts/aggregate_audio.py computes the audio table (voiced %, wpm, phrase rate, pauses, levels, flux at cuts, cut-to-word offsets) over all validated videos into evidence/audio_aggregate.json
lessons.full_mode_qa: In full mode QA does not require every small (<0.8 %) change to be attributed: A.fill_small is optional there; a cut-like event placed on a frame with 0 stage px (e.g. a removal one frame earlier) fails every_hard_cut_has_large_stage_change, so confirm the frame from the px series
